callSites.why: askJson passes a `fallbacks` list (server-side-fallback-2026-07-01 beta) whose model IDs the scan did not record. If it names claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, that fallback fails after 2026-11-30.
The agent loop also sends `fallbacks` with unrecorded model IDs. Any reference to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 must move to claude-sonnet-5-5.

record.prBody:
## claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 [Not affected]

### Change

No change. The repo never names claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. The primary model is claude-opus-5-5 (src/lib/claude.ts:6). Both call sites send fallbacks: "default" (claude.ts:29, finder.ts:126), so no fallback model ID is hard-coded. A repo-wide grep for "sonnet-4-5" and "20250929" outside node_modules and .next found nothing.

No files changed.

### Why

The retiring model ID is absent from the code, config and tests, so the retirement does not force any edit.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx --no-install next typegen` (RouteContext and LayoutProps are global helper types that Next generates into .next/types. Typecheck fails without them, and the install did not run any generation.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- What the server-side fallbacks: "default" resolves to is decided by the API. If it includes Sonnet 4.5, Anthropic handles that, not this repo.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

---

preparation.reasoning:
No codegen, prepare, or postinstall scripts exist, and there are no workspace packages to build, so no setup steps are needed. The build probably loads Supabase and Anthropic clients on the server side, and the README says env vars come from .env.example. I could not see that file, so these names are guesses at the usual ones and the values are placeholders only.
The only errors are missing RouteContext and LayoutProps. Next.js 15 and later generates these types with `next typegen`, which normally runs during dev or build. Running it before tsc fixes the typecheck without editing source. The build check generates them itself.
